name: RetroArch (mGBA)
location: RetroArch save folder (savefile_directory, sorted by core or content when enabled)
notes: The mGBA core exposes the save chip as RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM at its exact size (retro_get_memory_size, src/platform/libretro/libretro.c), without the clock; on the GBA, 128 KiB of 0xFF until the game has saved once. On the Game Boy, the cartridge RAM only (sramSize); the clock is RETRO_MEMORY_RTC, a separate .rtc file.
